## Summary of Changes
Provide a clear, high-level description of what this pull request changes and why.

## Related Issues
Fixes #(issue number) or Addresses #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change resolving an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update or correction
- [ ] Performance optimization or refactor
- [ ] CI / Tooling improvement

## Testing & Quality Checklist
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with zero errors.
- [ ] `npm test` passes all 40 unit and protocol tests.
- [ ] `npm run test:smoke` passes browser smoke and screenshot checks.
- [ ] Tested responsive layouts across desktop (1440px) and mobile (390px).
- [ ] Verified that `index.html` and `public/index.html` remain synchronized.
- [ ] Verified zero personal data, API secrets, or private invitation URLs are committed.
- [ ] Documented any new security or privacy implications in `SECURITY.md` or `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`.
